villagequests.note.hint: Lost it? Ask %1$s for another copy.
villagequests.place: in %1$s to the %2$s, about %3$s blocks from here
villagequests.button.decline.hover: Maybe later. They'll still need help.
villagequests.button.return.hover: Return it for a reward and their gratitude.
villagequests.button.keep.hover: Keep it for yourself. They might not believe you...
villagequests.say.declined: Oh... alright. If you change your mind, I'll be here.
villagequests.say.found_late: Is that %1$s? After all this time...
villagequests.say.returned: Oh, %1$s! I never thought I'd see it again. Thank you, truly. Please, take this.
villagequests.say.returned_late: You brought it back after all. Better late than never, I suppose.
villagequests.say.lied: You couldn't find it? ...I see. Thank you for trying, I suppose.
villagequests.say.lied_late: Nothing, after all this time? Hmph.
villagequests.say.grudge: You never came back with my heirloom. I trusted you.
villagequests.msg.too_far: You're too far away to answer.
villagequests.msg.too_many: You already have too many quests going. Finish or abandon one first (/villagequests list).
villagequests.msg.expired: You took too long. %1$s has given up waiting, and won't be happy to see you.
villagequests.msg.giver_died: %1$s has died. Whatever you were looking for is yours to keep now.
villagequests.msg.recovered: You recovered %1$s! Bring it back to %2$s (%3$s left)... or keep it for yourself.
villagequests.cmd.abandoned: You gave up on %1$s's request. They will remember.
villagequests.quest.villagequests.family: Oh, a friendly face, thank goodness! A dead man crawled out of the dark the other night and took our family sword right off the wall. Folk are calling him the %3$s. Could you find him and bring it back?
Bless you! He was last seen %2$s, around %3$s. Please bring it back within %4$s.
villagequests.quest.villagequests.miners: My grandfather's lucky pickaxe... he dropped it down in the deep years ago, and now a dead miner wanders down there swinging it. The %3$s, we call him. Would you bring it home for me?
You would? Wonderful! He haunts %2$s, around %3$s. Try to be back within %4$s.
villagequests.quest.villagequests.restle: My father was the best archer this village ever had. We buried his bow with him, but something dug it up: a skeleton that shoots just like he did. The %3$s. Please, get it back.
Thank you, friend. It was seen %2$s, near %3$s. Bring it back within %4$s, will you?
villagequests.quest.villagequests.desert: A pillager came through here alone, a deserter, I think. He stole the crossbow I spent years making, the finest I've ever built! The %3$s is camping somewhere nearby. Could you get it back before he sells it?
Really? Thank you! He made camp %2$s, around %3$s. He won't stay long, so please hurry: %4$s at most.
villagequests.say.errand_short: That's not quite %1$s. Come back when you have them all!
villagequests.say.later: No rush. Come back when you're ready.
villagequests.button.deliver.hover: Give them the items and collect your reward.
villagequests.msg.errand_lapsed: %1$s doesn't need your help anymore. Maybe next time.
villagequests.cmd.no_location: %1$s is an errand; it has no location to search.
villagequests.quest.villagequests.errand: Poppies for the Golems
Hey! Hey, you! The golems look so sad. Can you find me %2$s poppies? I'm gonna give them to ALL the golems!
Yay! %2$s poppies, don't forget! Mom says I have to be home by dark, so... within %4$s, okay?
Poppies! Thank you thank you! Come on, golems, I've got flowers for everyone!
Flowers for Mom
Psst. It's my mom's birthday and I don't have a present. Could you bring me %2$s flowers? Any kind! Pretty ones!
You're the best! Shh, it's a secret. %2$s flowers, within %4$s!
They're perfect! She's going to love them. Here, you can have my savings.
A Fish for the Stray Cat
There's a stray cat by the well and it looks really hungry. Could you catch %2$s fish for it? I'm not allowed near the water.
Thank you! Hurry, it looks so hungry. Within %4$s, please!
Look, it's eating! I'm going to call it Mister Whiskers. Thank you!
Shiny Rocks
I'm collecting shiny rocks! The purple glowy kind, from caves. Could you find me %2$s? Pleeease?
Really? %2$s of them! I'll make room on my shelf. Within %4$s, okay?
Ooooh, they sparkle! This is the best collection in the whole village.
%1$s's Spider Problem
Spiders. Every night they crawl over the fences and stare in my window with all those eyes. Bring me %2$s spider eyes so I know you've thinned them out.
Thank you. %2$s eyes, within %4$s. I'll be sleeping with the lights on until then.
Ugh, that's disgusting. And wonderful. I might actually sleep tonight.
Bone Meal for %1$s's Fields
The soil's worn out this year. If you could bring me %2$s bone meal, the crops might still come in before the frost.
Bless you. %2$s bone meal within %4$s and we'll have a harvest after all.
Look at that, green again already! Here, take these for your trouble.
%1$s's Empty Nets
My nets came up empty all week. Something's scaring the fish. Bring me %2$s salmon and I'll make it worth your while.
Good luck out there. %2$s salmon within %4$s, raw is fine.
Now those are proper fish! Maybe my luck's turning.
Wool for Winter Blankets
Winter's coming and half the village needs new blankets, but my sheep won't sit still. Could you bring me %2$s wool? Any color.
Wonderful. %2$s wool within %4$s and nobody freezes this year.
So soft! The children will be warm this winter, thanks to you.
%1$s's Late Shipment
The ore traders never showed up this month, and I've got orders piling up. I need %2$s iron ingots to finish them. Can you help?
You're a lifesaver. %2$s ingots within %4$s, and I can keep my promises.
Good, solid iron! My customers will never know how close it was.
Fuel for a Cold Forge
My fire's been going out all week. Could you bring me %2$s coal? Charcoal works too, I'm not picky.
Thanks! %2$s within %4$s, before my fire goes out for good.
Ahh, feel that heat! Back to work. Here, for your trouble.
A Copper Roof
I've got a commission for a copper roof, and I'm short. %2$s copper ingots would do it. It'll turn green beautifully in a few years.
Marvelous. %2$s ingots within %4$s, and the roof goes up on time.
Look at that shine! It won't last, of course. That's the beauty of it.
Leather for %1$s
Everyone wants new boots before winter and I'm out of hides. Could you bring me %2$s leather?
Thank you kindly. %2$s leather within %4$s.
Fine leather, this. You've got an eye for it.
Feathers for an Arrow Order
The guards ordered a mountain of arrows and I'm out of feathers. Bring me %2$s and I'll fletch you a few too.
Thanks! %2$s feathers within %4$s. Chickens beware.
Perfect fletching feathers! The guards will be pleased.
%1$s's Ruined Books
Some children used half my library to build a fort, in the rain. Could you bring me %2$s books to fill the gaps?
You're a scholar and a saint. %2$s books within %4$s.
Fresh pages! I'll start copying right away. Thank you, truly.
%1$s's Undead Studies
I'm studying the undead, purely for the good of the village, you understand. Bring me %2$s rotten flesh, would you?
Splendid. %2$s pieces within %4$s. Don't ask what for.
Fascinating... absolutely fascinating. Here, for your trouble. Wash your hands.
Paper for New Maps
I'm out of paper and there are so many maps left to draw. Could you bring me %2$s sheets?
Wonderful! %2$s sheets within %4$s, and the world gets a little less mysterious.
Crisp, clean paper! I know just where to start.
Something Pretty for %1$s's House
My house is so dreary. I saw cherry trees once, far from here, all pink... Could you bring me %2$s cherry leaves to brighten the place up?
Oh, would you? %2$s leaves within %4$s. I'll clear a spot by the window.
Pink! It's so pink! It finally feels like home in here.
Lanterns for the Dark Nights
The nights are so dark here, I can hear things moving outside. Could you bring me %2$s lanterns?
Thank you. %2$s lanterns within %4$s, and I'll stop jumping at shadows.
Ahh, light! Much better. Here, take this, you've earned it.
%1$s's Cake Dream
I had a dream about cake. A whole cake. Will you bring me one? Just one. It's important. I can't explain why.
Yes! Within %4$s. The dream was very clear about the timing.
It's exactly like the dream! ...It's smaller than the dream. Still! Thank you!
%1$s Wants a Pet
I want a pet slime. Well, the slimy bits will do. Bring me %2$s slimeballs? I'll name every one of them.
Wonderful! %2$s slimeballs within %4$s. I've already got names picked out.
This one's Gerald. And this is also Gerald. Thank you, friend!
villagequests.note.job: Find %1$s work: a free workstation near %2$s
villagequests.quest.villagequests.job_se: Excuse me... you wouldn't know anyone who's hiring, would you? I've been out of work for ages. If there were a free workstation anywhere near here, I'd take it in a heartbeat.
You'll help? Thank you! Any workstation will do: a composter, a lectern, a smoker, a loom... Put one somewhere near here and I'll come running. Within %2$s, if you can.
I'm a %2$s now! I have work! You did me a great service. Please, take this, and come see my shop today. I'll give you a good price.
villagequests.dialogue.greeting.adult: Oh! Excuse me... could you help me with something?
villagequests.dialogue.greeting.kid: Hey! Hey, you! Can I ask you something?
villagechatter.configuration.chatPrompts: Chat prompts when dialogue is off
villagequests.quest.villagequests.family: You look like you can handle yourself. My grandfather guarded our family sword for forty years, until he took an arrow to the knee. Now a dead thief has it. Folk call him the %3$s. Would you get it back?
Grandpa will cry. He cries a lot since the knee. The thief was seen %2$s, near %3$s. Within %4$s, please.
villagequests.quest.villagequests.restle: Father used to say a bow is only as good as the hand that holds it. Now a skeleton holds his, and it's terrifyingly good. The %3$s. Please, take it back from him.
Thank you. It haunts %2$s: %3$s. Bring it home within %4$s, if you can.
villagequests.quest.villagequests.errand: Psst! Do golems have feelings? I think they're sad. Poppies make everyone happy. Could you get me %2$s? For science!
Yesss! %2$s poppies. I'll make a chart of how happy each golem is. Within %4$s, okay?
Look how happy he is! Science is real! Thank you!
The big iron guy saved my cat from a zombie! I want to say thank you with flowers. %2$s poppies, please? That's how many he deserves.
You're the best! %2$s poppies, within %4$s. Don't tell him, it's a surprise.
He held up the poppy! Did you see? He held it up! I'm giving them all out right now!
You there. Adventurer. You look like someone who's killed a spider. Kill %2$s more and bring me their eyes. I have... reasons.
Good. %2$s eyes, within %4$s. Don't worry about the reasons.
Perfect. They'll look lovely in the jar with the others. What? Nothing. Thank you.
I'm brewing my strongest potion yet. Far too strong for you, traveler, but I'll need %2$s rotten flesh to finish it.
Yes, yes. %2$s pieces within %4$s. And no, you can't try the potion. You couldn't handle it.
Excellent. My strongest potion will be ready soon. You still can't have any. Here, take this instead.
Everyone keeps telling me the cake is a lie. I need to know for sure. Bring me %2$s cake?
Within %4$s! Science depends on it.
It's real. The cake is real! I knew it! Everyone owes me an apology.
There's a cardboard box sneaking around at night. When I hold up a torch, it freezes. Bring me %2$s lanterns, I want to see it coming.
%2$s lanterns, within %4$s. Then we'll see who's sneaking.
Light! Now let's see that box try to sneak past my house. Thank you, friend.
villagequests.quest.villagequests.job_se: I've been unemployed so long I've started telling people I'm a consultant. Know any free workstations? Lectern, composter, anything at all.
Really? A workstation near here, any kind, and I'll take it. Within %2$s, if you can. My savings won't last.
Look at me! A %2$s! A real job! No more consulting! Take these, and come by the shop today. Friends' prices.
Every morning the other villagers walk off to work and I just... stand by the bell. Could you find me a job? Any free workstation will do.
Thank you! Put any workstation near here and I'll claim it before anyone else does. Within %2$s, please.
I'm a %2$s now! I walked to work this morning like everyone else! Here, for you, and a discount at my shop today.
villagequests.rumor.0: One of ours ran off %2$s, about %3$s blocks, swearing there was %1$s out there. Never came back.
villagequests.rumor.1: My uncle says there's %1$s about %3$s blocks %2$s of here. My uncle also says he's seen a pig fly.
villagequests.rumor.2: A traveler came through last week, babbling about %1$s off to the %2$s. Maybe %3$s blocks. He looked haunted.
villagequests.rumor.3: Go %2$s about %3$s blocks and you'll find %1$s. Or so they say. Nobody who says it has been.
villagequests.rumor.4: Don't tell the others I told you: there's %1$s %2$s of here. %3$s blocks, give or take a creeper.
villagequests.rumor.5: The wandering trader mentioned %1$s, roughly %3$s blocks %2$s. He wanted three emeralds for the rest. I didn't pay.
villagequests.dialogue.remembered.adult: Oh! That reminds me... I could actually use some help with something.
villagequests.dialogue.remembered.kid: Ooh, wait! I just remembered something! Can I ask you a favor?
villagequests.quest.villagequests.lost_b: My buddy %2$s went out hunting four days ago and never came back. There's a pillager camp out that way... I can't sleep. Would you look for him?
Thank you, thank you. Last I saw, %2$s headed %3$s, somewhere around %4$s. If he's alive, he'll follow an emerald block anywhere. Please hurry: %5$s at most.
Home! Real beds! Real bread! %1$s, I'm back! Thank you, friend. I owe you my life. Here, everything I had in my pockets.
%2$s and I had a silly fight, and he stormed off toward the pillager tower. That was days ago. If something happened to him... Please, find %2$s.
Bless you. He went %3$s, near %4$s as best I can tell. Show him an emerald block and he'll follow you home. He's always been like that. %5$s, please.
%1$s! I'm sorry about the fight! Friend, thank you. Those pillagers kept asking if I knew any good recipes. I didn't. Take this.
villagequests.rescue.found: You... you came! Did %1$s send you? Get me out of here! Hold up an emerald block and I'll follow you anywhere.
villagequests.rescue.following: Lead the way, I'm right behind you. Just keep that emerald block where I can see it!
villagequests.rumor.lead.good.2: You've been good to us, so...
villagequests.rumor.lead.rare.0: For you? I'll tell you the real secret.
villagequests.rumor.lead.rare.1: Only a friend gets to hear this.
villagequests.rumor.precise.0: There's a %1$s %2$s of here, about %3$s blocks. Right around %4$s, %5$s. Go see.
villagequests.rumor.precise.1: A %1$s. %2$s, near %4$s, %5$s. Roughly %3$s blocks. You didn't hear it from me.
villagequests.rumor.precise.2: My grandfather marked it: a %1$s at %4$s, %5$s. That's %2$s, %3$s blocks or so.
villagequests.rumor.biome.land.0: Travelers talk of %1$s out %2$s, maybe %3$s blocks. Never been myself.
villagequests.rumor.biome.land.1: Go %2$s about %3$s blocks and you'll find %1$s. Strange, beautiful place.
villagequests.rumor.biome.land.2: %1$s, %2$s of here. %3$s blocks or so. My cousin swears by it.
villagequests.rumor.biome.land.3: If you like wandering: %1$s, %2$s, about %3$s blocks.
villagequests.rumor.biome.cave.0: The miners whisper about %1$s deep under the ground %2$s, maybe %3$s blocks.
villagequests.rumor.biome.cave.1: Dig down %2$s of here, around %3$s blocks, and you'll hit %1$s. Bring torches.
villagequests.rumor.biome.cave.2: Under the hills %2$s, about %3$s blocks: %1$s. I heard it breathing once.
villagequests.rumor.biome.cave.3: There's %1$s below us, %2$s, %3$s blocks off. Not a place for the faint-hearted.
villagequests.dialogue.option.parcel_rep: Your friend sent a letter back.
villagequests.courier.greet_recipient: Hm? That bundle... is that for me?
villagequests.courier.greet_reply: Oh! Did you make it to the other village?
villagequests.courier.package_lore: For %1$s, in the village %2$s, about %3$s blocks
villagequests.courier.reply_ask: Would you take this letter back to %s for me?
villagequests.courier.reply_thanks: A letter back! Oh, you are a treasure. Here, for the walk.
villagequests.courier.discovered: Word travels: %s vouched for you, and this village is warmer toward you now.
villagequests.courier.nowhere: Hm. Come to think of it, I don't know where the next village even is. Never mind.
villagequests.note.village: Deliver it in the village named above. Ask around there.
villagequests.quest.villagequests.courie: Too many eggs this season! My friend in the next village could use some. Could you carry %2$s over for me?
Wonderful! Take these to %4$s in the village %5$s of here, about %6$s blocks. Before %7$s, or they'll spoil!
Eggs for %4$s (village %5$s, ~%6$s blocks)
Eggs from %2$s? Ha! That old goat remembered. Thank you, traveler.
I've a letter that needs to reach the next village. Would you carry it? It's... personal.
Bless you. Give it to %4$s in the village %5$s, about %6$s blocks. Within %7$s, if you can. And don't read it!
A sealed letter (village %5$s, ~%6$s blocks)
A letter from %2$s! It's been so long. Thank you, really.
We librarians trade books between villages. Could you carry %2$s of mine to the next one over?
Excellent. To %4$s in the village %5$s, about %6$s blocks. Within %7$s, please. Mind the bindings.
Books for %4$s (village %5$s, ~%6$s blocks)
From %2$s's shelves? Oh, I've been waiting for these!
I've wool to spare and a friend who needs it. Could you carry %2$s over to the next village?
Thank you! A %4$s in the village %5$s, about %6$s blocks. Within %7$s.
Wool for %4$s (village %5$s, ~%6$s blocks)
Wool from %2$s! Soft as ever. Tell them thank you.
Good catch today, too good. Could you rush %2$s fish to the next village before they turn?
Quick now! A %4$s in the village %5$s, about %6$s blocks. Within %7$s, or it's fish soup for nobody.
Fresh fish for %4$s (village %5$s, ~%6$s blocks). Hurry!
Still fresh! %2$s's fish are the best on the coast. Thank you!
Someone's ill in the next village. Could you carry %2$s of these to the cleric there? It may help.
Hurry, friend. The %4$s in the village %5$s, about %6$s blocks. Within %7$s.
Medicine for %4$s (village %5$s, ~%6$s blocks)
From %2$s? Oh, thank the stars. This will help.
The smith in the next village is short on iron. Could you carry %2$s ingots over? We smiths stick together.
Good. To %4$s in the village %5$s, about %6$s blocks. Within %7$s.
Iron for %4$s (village %5$s, ~%6$s blocks)
Iron from %2$s! Now the forge can sing again. Thank you.
We swap seeds between villages to keep the crops strong. Could you carry %2$s over?
Thank you! To %4$s in the village %5$s, about %6$s blocks. Within %7$s.
Seeds for %4$s (village %5$s, ~%6$s blocks)
Seeds from %2$s! Next year's harvest thanks you.
I've copied a map for my colleague in the next village. Would you deliver it?
Mind it doesn't get wet. To %4$s in the village %5$s, about %6$s blocks. Within %7$s.
A map for %4$s (village %5$s, ~%6$s blocks)
A copy from %2$s! Their linework is still the best. Thank you.
villagequests.journal.title: Village Quests
villagequests.journal.empty: No villager has asked you for help yet.
villagequests.journal.status.build_far: Go back to the village to check
villagequests.journal.status.courier: Deliver to a %1$s, in the village %2$s (~%3$s blocks), %4$s left
villagequests.fail.expired: Failed: too late, and %1$s holds a grudge
villagequests.dialogue.option.quit_0: I can't do this after all, sorry.
villagequests.dialogue.option.quit_1: About that favor... I don't want to do it anymore.
villagequests.say.quit.0: Oh. I see. Well... thanks for considering it, I suppose.
villagequests.say.quit.1: Hm. That's a shame. I'll manage.
An Iron Golem for %1$s's Village
We don't have a golem. Every night I hear zombies scratching at the doors, and nobody's coming to save us. Could you build us one? Four blocks of iron and a carved pumpkin, the old stories say.
You'll do it? Bless you! Build it right here in the village, within %3$s if you can. We'll sleep easier the moment it's standing.
Look at it! Our very own golem! I feel safer already. Take this, friend. You've earned it ten times over.
You've seen other villages, right? They all have a big iron friend watching over them. We have... a fence. Could you build us a golem?
Really? Iron blocks in a T, a pumpkin on top, and it wakes right up! In the village, within %3$s, please.
He's huge! He's perfect! The children have already named him three different things. Thank you!
A Bell for %1$s's Village
We have no bell. No meeting place, no warning when raiders come. Could you put up a bell somewhere in the village?
Thank you! Anywhere central will do. Within %3$s, if you can manage it.
Ding! Oh, I've missed that sound. Now we have somewhere to gather. Thank you, truly.
Beds for %1$s's Village
Some of us have been sleeping on the floor. There just aren't enough beds. We'd need %2$s in the village, all told. Could you help?
Oh, my back thanks you already. Put them anywhere in the village. %2$s beds, within %3$s.
A real bed! I'd forgotten what that feels like. Everyone will sleep well tonight. Thank you.
Light Up %1$s's Street
It's so dark around here at night, the zombies walk right up to the doors. Could you put up some light? Torches, lanterns, anything. %2$s of them near here would do it.
Thank you. %2$s lights around here, within %3$s. I'll stop jumping at every shadow.
Look at that glow! I can finally see the path at night. Thank you, friend.
A Fence for %1$s's Village
Pillagers, zombies, a very rude goat... anything just walks right in here. Could you fence the place in a bit? %2$s pieces of fence or wall around here would help.
Excellent. %2$s fences or walls around here, within %3$s. And put in a gate, so we can still get out!
Now that's a proper village. Let that goat try it now. Thank you!
More Fields for %1$s
There are more mouths to feed every season and my fields aren't big enough. Could you till some more farmland around here? %2$s blocks of it, all told.
Wonderful! Till it near my fields, %2$s blocks in all, within %3$s. Water nearby helps.
Look at all that soil! I'll have seeds in by tonight. Here, for your blisters.
villagequests.journal.status.courier_rep: Bring the reply letter back to %1$s (%2$s left)
villagequests.fail.recipient_died: Failed: %2$s died. %1$s owes you something for your trouble
villagequests.fail.recipient_died_paid: Failed: %2$s died (%1$s paid you for your time)
villagequests.msg.recipient_died: %1$s has died. %2$s will want to hear about it, and won't let you leave empty-handed.
villagequests.say.compensation.0: Aw... %1$s died? That's awful. That really sucks. Here, take this for your time. It's the least I can do.
villagequests.say.compensation.1: %1$s is gone? Oh, that's terrible news. You did your best. Please, take something for your trouble.
villagequests.say.compensation.2: Oh no. Poor %1$s. ...Well, it's not your fault, friend. Here, for the walk at least.
villagequests.courier.spotted: You spot %1$s, the %2$s your package is for.
villagequests.gift.love.0: %1$s?! For me? Oh, friend, you shouldn't have. I'll treasure this.
villagequests.gift.love.1: Oh! %1$s! How did you know? This is exactly what I've been wanting!
villagequests.gift.love.2: You remembered! ...Or you guessed. Either way: %1$s! Thank you!
villagequests.gift.love.3: Now THIS is a gift. %1$s. I'm going to tell everyone about this.
villagequests.gift.love.4: I... I don't know what to say. %1$s. You're a good soul.
villagequests.gift.like.0: %1$s? That's very kind of you. Thank you.
villagequests.gift.like.1: Oh, %1$s! I can use this. Thank you, friend.
villagequests.gift.like.2: How thoughtful. %1$s will come in handy.
villagequests.gift.like.3: For me? %1$s. Well, isn't that nice.
villagequests.gift.like.4: Thank you! %1$s is just the thing.
villagequests.gift.meh.0: Oh. %1$s. Sure, I'll... add it to my storage. Thanks.
villagequests.gift.meh.1: %1$s? Hm. Well, it's the thought that counts.
villagequests.gift.meh.2: That's... a %1$s. Thank you, I suppose.
villagequests.gift.meh.3: Ah. %1$s. I'll find a use for it. Probably.

villagequests.gift.reject.3: Hm, no. %1$s is more someone else's sort of thing.

villagequests.msg.item_lost: The %1$s is gone. Let %2$s know what happened; they won't send you away empty-handed.
villagequests.say.compensation_lost.0: Oh no... the %1$s is gone? Well. These things happen. Here, something for your effort.

villagequests.say.compensation_lost.2: The %1$s, gone for good. That's a shame. Still, you tried. Here.
villagequests.msg.giver_moved: %1$s seems to have moved. They live in %2$s now.
villagequests.guard.greeting.0: Citizen. A word, if you've got a moment.
villagequests.guard.greeting.1: You look capable. Mind if I ask you something?
villagequests.guard.greeting.2: Hold up. You. Could use a hand with something.
villagequests.guard.later: Whenever you're ready. I'm not going anywhere. That's sort of the job.
villagequests.guard.quit: Hm. Fine. I'll manage with what I've got.
A New Sword for %1$s
My blade's chipped to ribbons. Three raids and a very determined spider. Could you bring me a new sword? Any sword. I'm not picky, I'm desperate.
Appreciated. Any sword will do, within %4$s. Until then I'll be poking zombies with a stick.
Now that's a blade. The village sleeps safer tonight, and so do I. I owe you one, citizen.
I'll be honest with you: my sword snapped on a skeleton last night. Don't tell the others. Could you get me a new one?
Quietly, if you can. Within %4$s. My reputation depends on it.
Not a word to anyone, yes? ...Thank you. Really.
A Shield for %1$s
Skeletons have been taking potshots at me every night. I could really use a shield. Could you bring me one?
Thank you. A shield within %4$s, and I'll stop catching arrows with my face.
Solid. Let them shoot now. You have my thanks, citizen.
Armor for %1$s
This armor's more dents than metal. Could you bring me a new chestplate? Iron if you can, leather if you must.
Good. A chestplate within %4$s. I'll try not to get stabbed in the meantime.
Fits like it was made for me. I won't forget this.
A Helmet for %1$s
A creeper took my helmet. And nearly my head. Bring me a new one, would you?
Thanks. A helmet within %4$s. I'll keep my head down till then.
Much better. My head thanks you. The rest of me too.
Arrows for %1$s
We're low on arrows and the nights keep getting longer. Could you bring me %2$s? The fletcher's backed up for a week.
Good. %2$s arrows within %4$s. Every one of them will find a zombie.
A full quiver! Let them come. Thank you, citizen.
Beds for the Village, for %1$s
Hey, we could really use some beds. Folks are sleeping in the open, and I can't guard everyone at once. %2$s beds in the village would let me sleep at night. Metaphorically.
Thank you. Get the village up to %2$s beds within %3$s, and I'll breathe easier.
Everyone's indoors tonight. You've made my job a lot easier, citizen.
villagequests.pet.come_home: Come on, %1$s, let's get you home to %2$s. (Talk to it: stay, follow, go home...)
villagequests.journal.status.pet_followi: %1$s is following you; bring them to %2$s
villagequests.quest.villagequests.lost_p: Have you seen my %2$s? %3$s ran off yesterday and didn't come back for dinner. %3$s ALWAYS comes back for dinner. Can you find %3$s? Please?
Really?! %2$s went %3$s, I think. Somewhere around %4$s. Just pat %2$s on the head and say it's time to go home. Hurry, %5$s at most!
%2$s!!! You're back! Bad %2$s! Good %2$s! Thank you thank you thank you. Here, you can have my %3$s. It's my best one.
%3$s is gone! My %2$s! I only left the door open for a teeny bit. Will you help me look? I'm not allowed to leave the village.
Okay! %2$s likes to go %3$s. Around %4$s, maybe? If you find %2$s, just pet %2$s and say "home". Before %5$s, okay? Mom says that's too long.
%2$s! You smell like a swamp! I missed you so much. Thanks! This %3$s is for you. Don't tell anyone where I found it.
villagequests.guard.quit_paid: Fair enough. You did put some of it up. Here, for your trouble.
Fortify the Village for %1$s
Our walls are a joke. A zombie could stroll in for tea. Could you put up some defenses? %2$s should do it: walls, fences, gates, sturdy doors. Anything that makes a raider think twice.
Good. %2$s defensive blocks, anywhere in the village, within %3$s. I'll be watching the gaps.
Look at that. Real defenses. Next raid's going to have a very bad day. You've earned this, citizen.
Between you and me, last night's raid got a lot closer than I'd like. We need %2$s defensive blocks around the village. Fences, walls, gates, whatever you can find. Up for it?
Appreciated. %2$s of them, inside the village, before %3$s are out. I'll sleep better. Well, I won't sleep. But I'll feel better.
Now that's a village I can defend. Thank you. I'll tell the others you're good people.
villagequests.pet.kept: You kept the pet. %1$s won't forget that.
villagequests.golem.greeting.0: *The golem rumbles and looks at you, then out past the houses.*
villagequests.golem.greeting.1: *The golem steps in front of you. Not threatening. Waiting.*
villagequests.golem.greeting.2: *A low grinding hum. The golem points toward the wilds.*
villagequests.golem.declined: *The golem lowers its arm and turns back to its watch.*
villagequests.golem.later: *The golem nods, slowly. It will wait.*
villagequests.golem.quit: *The golem looks away. Something in it sags.*
villagequests.golem.nevermind: *The golem looks out at the wilds, then shakes its head. Not today.*
*The golem counts the houses on its fingers. One short. It points past the fields and rumbles a name: %2$s.* (One of the village's own is lost out there. Will you bring them back?)
*The golem holds one hand low to the ground, then points away from the village. Someone small. Someone missing: %2$s.* (Will you find them?)
*The golem points, hard. %2$s went %3$s, somewhere around %4$s.* (Bring them back within %5$s.)
*A heavy nod toward the wilds. %2$s is %3$s, around %4$s.* (Within %5$s.)
Home! I got so turned around out there. Thank you! The big iron one will be so relieved.
We're back! I'm never wandering off again. Probably. Thank you!
